name: P-Shot®
desc: Autologous platelet-rich plasma to regenerate vascular and erectile tissue — introduced to the UK by Dr Wakil.
imageAlt: P-Shot® platelet-rich plasma treatment at Dr SW Clinics

conditions.plain: difficulty getting or keeping an erection
curvature or scarring of the penis
recovery of function after prostate surgery

intro: The P-Shot® uses your own platelet-rich plasma to regenerate vascular and erectile tissue at the source. Dr Wakil introduced the technique to the UK and has performed it more than any other physician in the country.

price.note: Replace this in the CMS. Confirmed at consultation; 0% finance available.

benefits: Uses your own blood products — nothing synthetic is introduced
Treats the vascular cause rather than masking the symptom
No surgery and no downtime — most patients return to their day
Combines with ESWT shockwave for compounding effect
Performed by the physician who brought the technique to the UK

howItWorks.title: Diagnose
howItWorks.detail: The Endo Test gives a full hormonal and vascular picture before anything is decided.

howItWorks.title: Draw
howItWorks.detail: A small sample of your own blood is taken, as for any routine blood test.

howItWorks.title: Concentrate
howItWorks.detail: The sample is spun to separate and concentrate the platelets and growth factors.

howItWorks.title: Deliver
howItWorks.detail: The concentrate is placed precisely into the tissue under topical anaesthetic.

faqs.a: Topical anaesthetic is applied first and most patients describe pressure rather than pain. The appointment takes about 45 minutes in total.

faqs.q: When will I notice a difference?
faqs.a: Some men notice change within three weeks. The regenerative effect builds over roughly three months as new tissue forms.
The injectate is made from your own blood, so there is no risk of rejection or allergy. It is performed by a physician in a CQC-registered clinic.
